items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I wrote that for Milton Nascimento.

ctx.x: There’s a piece entitled “Milton.” Is that an homage?
Yeah, I wrote that for Milton Nascimento.

Subsequent to this, there are other recordings of Special Edition, other incarnations of the group later in the decade of the 80’s. We can jump to those, or we can talk about the formation and the beginning of The Standards Trio and how did that come about.
